log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Noivern

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega Floette. Lead Ape+Maushold T1: Follow Me enables Ape CC Arch (breaks Stamina) or IcePunch Scizor (freeze) while Friend Guard holds; Defiant beats Intimidate. Back Floette+Pult: Mega Fairy after Scizor cleared; Pult sash Flamethrower steels + outspeeds Noivern. Flex vs rain/screens.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect); Grimm clay Prankster (Reflect/LS/FakeOut/FoulPlay); Staraptor WideLens Intimidate (BraveBird/CC/FinalGambit/Protect). G1 rain (Arch/Poli/Scizor/Noivern); G2 screens (Grimm/Staraptor/Scizor/Noivern). Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. ES/Blitz weak into Scizor; respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. Avoid Mega Floette into Scizor (BP SE, Fairy resisted). Hisui Arcanine 4x water in rain—bench vs Poli. Pult Flamethrower covers steels.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Scizor-Mega. Lead Scizor+Politoed: Drizzle rain halves all Fire moves (Arcanine Flare Blitz, Dragapult Flamethrower), and Politoed Hydro Pump guaranteed-OHKOs Arcanine-Hisui (4x Water in rain). Turn 1 Scizor Protects to Mega Evolve safely while Politoed removes the primary Fire threat. Backline Noivern (192 Spe, Draco Meteor for Dragapult/Annihilape chip, Super Fang utility, Focus Sash) + Staraptor (Brave Bird possible-OHKOs Annihilape at 2x SE, Final Gambit emergency, speed 167 o
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1, Game 3 decisive. Scizor-Mega is MVP: Bullet Punch (Technician 1.5x, ~60 BP effective) priority sweeps chipped teams. Rain from Politoed Drizzle is critical — halves Fire moves, turning Arcanine Flare Blitz from guaranteed OHKO to possible OHKO (45-141%), and neuters Dragapult Flamethrower. Politoed Hydro Pump guaranteed-OHKOs Arcanine-Hisui (4x Water vs Fire/Rock in rain). Scizor-Mega resists Dragapult's Dragon/Ghost at 0.25x. Noivern Draco Meteor can't OHKO Annihilape from full (neutral, 23-78%) — Staraptor Brave Bird is the Annihilape answer (2x SE, 54-182%). Staraptor Intimidate triggers Annihilape Defiant — must KO with Brave Bird same turn or avoid switching Staraptor in while Annihilape is alive. Grimmsnarl Fake Out useless vs 3 Ghost types on opponent team (Annihilape/Dragapult/Basculegion). Opponent likely adapts g3: may swap Maushold or Annihilape for Dragapult (speed, Focus Sash, Flamethrower for Scizor). Basculegion is NVE vs Scizor-Mega (Water 0.5x, Ghost 0.25x) despite Adaptability — not a real threat. Plan: Protect Scizor T1 to Mega Evolve, Hydro Pump Arcanine, then BP sweep with rain active. Noivern breaks Dragapult Focus Sash, Scizor-Mega BP finishes.

decisions.rationale: FM (+2) redirects both single-target threats onto Maus; Ape is immune to CC and free to slam Poli (45-85% CC) to pressure Drizzle/Sitrus before rain turns waste. Survives any BP redirect via Friend Guard support context; Pop Bomb too weak/slow vs rain.

ES/Blitz weak into Scizor; respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. Avoid Mega Floette into Scizor (BP SE, Fairy resisted). Pult Flamethrower covers steels. FM protects Ape vs Poli rain water.

decisions.rationale: Maushold dead; bring sash Pult. Flamethrower pressures -1 SpD Mega Scizor; Clear Body/sash vs chip. Floette loses hard to Technician BP and resists little here. Ape stays for Defiant/CC pressure.

Close Combat is 2x SE vs Maushold (83-196%, possible OHKO with Mega 222 Atk) while Politoed Protects from Annihilape's Close Combat (87-154% OHKO threat). FollowMe redirect is irrelevant since I target Maushold anyway. If Maushold Protects, both sides waste attacks but Scizor Megas safely. TidyUp doesn't redirect, so CC still hits. BP only does 21-50% — not enough. Scizor-Mega's CC defense drop is negligible since Annihilape does 0.25-0.5x to it.

Annihilape Close Combat does 87-154% to Politoed — possible OHKO, must Protect Politoed when Annihilape is active. Maushold FollowMe (+2 pri) outspeeds Scizor BP (+1 pri) but redirect is irrelevant when targeting Maushold directly.

decisions.rationale: Rain halves Flame but Scizor -1 SpD makes Pult Flame ~57-100%+; Ape Protect blanks Technician BP and rain water while Pult outspeeds. Focus fire risks Ape chip then Poli KO; sash absorbs Ice Beam. Keep Ape healthy for later Arch/CC.

Scizor Protect guarantees MVP survives Dragapult's rain-halved Flamethrower (37–128% adjusted for -1 SpD, real OHKO risk). Politoed Ice Beam chips Dragapult to 9–74% (2x SE, no STAB). Annihilape Close Combat only OHKOs Politoed at the very top of its 29.9–104.2% range; Sitrus Berry aids survival. Next turn Scizor Bullet Punch KOs chipped Dragapult. Best balance of safety and progress.

decisions.rationale: Pult sashless at 27% dies to BP or Ice Beam; must Protect. Ape CC Scizor exploits -1 Def for strong chip while Scizor Protect odds are reduced. Avoid Floette into BP. Rain cuts Flame; don't sac Pult this turn.

Bullet Punch (+1 priority) hits Dragapult before it can move; at 26% HP there's ~65% KO chance. Politoed Protects to stay safe from Annihilape Close Combat (37-86%, survivable but no need to tank it). If BP KOs, Politoed is pristine for rain + Hydro Pump on Arcanine later. If BP misses, finish Dragapult next turn with Ice Beam. Double-targeting wastes Ice Beam when BP KOs and needlessly damages Politoed.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 G3. Annihilape Close Combat vs Politoed is 37-86% — CANNOT OHKO, Politoed always survives. This means Politoed need not Protect vs Annihilape when securing a KO is more valuable. Scizor-Mega -1 SpD makes Dragapult Flamethrower possible OHKO (~46-108% with boost) — must respect this threat. Bullet Punch (Technician 60 BP + STAB = 90 effective) does 19.5-42.9% to Dragapult — not guaranteed KO from 26%. Future: if Dragapult survives, Politoed Ice Beam finishes. Arcanine-Hisui switch-in is answered by Politoed Hydro Pump (4x rain OHKO). Staraptor Brave Bird is Annihilape answer but Intimidate triggers Defiant — only bring Staraptor to KO Annihilape same turn.

decisions.rationale: Scizor at 31% Def-1 dies to either CC or Flame; double up guarantees KO through Protect while Pult outspeeds and Flame is 4x. Ape lives BP/U-turn; leftover Poli pressure next. Avoid Pult Protect fail and free Ice Beam.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Dragapult at 26% must die this turn. Protect Scizor blocks the obvious Flamethrower (4x SE, guaranteed KO with -1 SpD). Politoed Ice Beam guarantees Dragapult KO at 26%. If opponent targets Politoed instead, Politoed survives with Sitrus Berry and still KOs Dragapult. Only double-targeting Politoed punishes this, which requires a specific read. Best risk-reward in a must-win game 3.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 G3. Key damage facts: Bullet Punch 19.5-42.9% to Dragapult (~72% KO from 26%, not guaranteed). Flamethrower 30.5-71.7% base to Scizor, ~46-108% with -1 SpD = guaranteed KO at 32%. Politoed Ice Beam 2x SE on Dragapult always KOs at 26%. Annihilape Close Combat 37-86% on Politoed (never OHKO). Scizor-Mega base Speed 95, Politoed 100 — both underspeed Annihilape (121-156) and Dragapult (178-213). Rain Dance has 2 turns left. Staraptor Intimidate triggers Annihilape Defiant — only bring Staraptor to KO Annihilape same turn. Arcanine-Hisui switch-in answered by Politoed Hydro Pump (4x rain). Floette-Eternal is unrevealed back Pokémon with Floettite (Mega).

decisions.rationale: Ape CC guarantees KO on 31% Scizor after any BP. Floette Protect blocks priority BP and rain Water; rain ends this turn. Avoid Mega into live Scizor BP. Poli cannot OHKO Ape.

Scizor is guaranteed dead to Annihilape CC but Bullet Punch (priority +1) fires first for 44.8-104.7% on Floette. Weather Ball (100% acc, rain+STAB) adds 37.6-79.2%, combined likely KOing Floette. Opponent has only 2 Pokemon left; KOing Floette makes it 3v1 Annihilape. Even if Floette Protects, I'm still 3v2 with Politoed at full. Weather Ball chosen over Hydro Pump for guaranteed accuracy.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 G3. Opponent brought Annihilape+Dragapult+Maushold+Floette-Eternal; Arcanine-Hisui and Basculegion not brought. Floette-Eternal has Floettite (no Mega stats found via lookup — base SpA 125, SpD 128, Spe 92, HP 74). Floette moves: Moonblast, Light of Ruin (140 BP/90% acc), Energy Ball, Protect. Annihilape Defiant — never bring Staraptor unless KOing Annihilape same turn. Rain Dance from Politoed Drizzle. Noivern 192 Spe outspeeds all opponent Pokemon. If Floette is KO'd, opponent has only Annihilape left — clean up with Noivern Hurricane (2x SE on Fighting) or Staraptor Brave Bird. Staraptor Final Gambit can KO any single target if HP > target HP.

decisions.rationale: Noivern outspeeds all foes (192 Spe), Focus Sash guarantees one-hit survival, and avoids triggering Annihilape's Defiant. Next turn Draco Meteor on -2 SpD Annihilape at 90% acc is the primary win con — likely OHKO with doubled special damage. Staraptor's Intimidate would boost Annihilape's Atk via Defiant, making it strictly worse here.

Noivern Hurricane on Annihilape at -2 SpD is a likely OHKO but 70% acc without rain.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Noivern) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Noivern sash Infiltrator outspeeds; Ice Punch 4x forces sash then Mega LoR KOes through sash (Fairy 2x). Ape tanky enough vs Hurricane after -2; Floette needs Mega for power. Poli slower, can chip later. Avoid Protect fail on Floette.

Draco Meteor at 90% acc is the best KO shot on -2 SpD Annihilape (82-179% adjusted range, likely OHKO on Jolly min-SpD spread). Politoed Protect shields it from Energy Ball 2x SE and Close Combat; if Annihilape is KO'd, Politoed's attack would be wasted anyway. 90% hit + likely OHKO = ~83% clean win-out. If miss, Politoed preserved for cleanup with Staraptor backup.

decisions.rationale: Noiv at 1%: Moonblast (Fairy Aura) secures KO if it stays. Survive any single Poli hit at 51%. LoR recoil/90% worse; EB leaves Noiv alive to chip/KO. Protect cedes free turn.

Floette is opponent's last Pokémon — KO wins the series. Noivern outspeeds Floette (192 vs 122-154), so Super Fang halves Floette from 50% to 25% before it can act or Protect. Politoed Hydro Pump (21.5-46.3% max HP) easily KOs 25% Floette. 72% combined KO chance this turn. If Floette Protects, we still have Politoed+Staraptor vs 50% Floette next turn — winning position regardless.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1 G3. Opponent brought Annihilape+Dragapult+Maushold+Floette-Eternal; Arcanine-Hisui and Basculegion not brought. Floette-Eternal has Floettite (Mega: Fairy-type, Fairy Aura, base SpA 125, SpD 128, Spe 92, HP 74). Floette moves: Moonblast, Light of Ruin (140 BP/90% acc), Energy Ball, Protect. Annihilape Defiant — never bring Staraptor unless KOing Annihilape same turn. Noivern 192 Spe outspeeds all opponent Pokemon. Staraptor Final Gambit can KO any single target if HP >= target HP. Rain expired turn 5. Politoed Hydro Pump does 21.5-46.3% to Floette-Mega (neutral Water vs Fairy). Ice Beam does 11.6-25.5%. Super Fang halves current HP regardless of SpA drops.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview brought Mega Floette + Maushold into opp rain (Poli/Scizor/Noivern); Floette is poor vs Scizor BP and rain water, Maushold unused, Pult farmed by Ice Beam.
reflections.adjustment: Do not lock Mega Floette or this four vs rain—park Floette, prefer Ape Ice Punch pressure and Pult Flamethrower with a better fourth that answers Poli/Noivern.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect); Grimm clay Prankster (Reflect/LS/FakeOut/FoulPlay); Staraptor WideLens Intimidate (BraveBird/CC/FinalGambit/Protect). Modes: rain G1/G3 (Arch/Poli/Scizor/Noivern), screens G2 (Grimm/Staraptor/Scizor/Noivern). Poli Protect-spam + Ice Beam dragons; Noivern Super Fang post-sash. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. ES/Blitz weak into Scizor; respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. Avoid Mega Floette into Scizor/rain (BP SE, Fairy resisted, water weak). Pult Flamethrower covers steels. FM protects Ape vs Poli rain water only if Scizor already gone.

reflections.summary: Won through efficient piece trading: Politoed chunked and KO'd Dragapult with Ice Beam across turns 2-4, Noivern's Focus Sash let it survive Floette-Mega's Light of Ruin while Draco Meteor KO'd Annihilape on turn 6, then Super Fang + Hydro Pump cleaned up Floette-Mega on turn 7. Scizor-Mega served mainly as a sack to bring Noivern in safely. Staraptor was never fielded because Annihilape's Defiant makes Intimidate a liability — effectively a dead slot.
reflections.adjustment: Staraptor contributed nothing this game due to Annihilape's Defiant. When Annihilape is confirmed in preview, either replace Staraptor with a non-Intimidate fourth or commit to an explicit Final Gambit plan targeting Floette-Mega before it can move. Also evaluate whether Scizor-Mega is the right Mega here — its offensive output was minimal and it functioned mostly as a sack, so a Mega that pressures Floette-Mega + Annihilape more directly may be better.
reflections.notebook: Series won 2-1. Floette-Mega Light of Ruin nearly KOs Noivern (Focus Sash required to survive). Super Fang + Hydro Pump reliably finishes Floette-Mega from ~50%. Annihilape Defiant makes Staraptor (Intimidate) a liability — avoid bringing Staraptor when Annihilape is confirmed unless Final Gambit targets a same-turn KO. Opponent brought Maushold but never fielded it (possible dead slot). Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch forces Dragapult to respect priority but offers limited offensive value vs Floette-Mega + Annihilape cores.
